original_semantics: Race working memory is reused. Lap slots and totals remain in SRAM; result computes extrema over non-sentinel lap slots with minimum range200. Native result retains its final race state as an archive, not a projection of overwritten graphics memory.
restart: Explicit fresh same-scenario initialization, not automatic next-tour progression.
pending: Result state, both outcomes, visual contract and restart must pass independent validation before acceptance.
